notes.title: Release of KUBEON version 0.9.0
notes.notes:
Release of KUBEON version 0.9.0


The 0.9.0 version of Kubeon brings the following changes:

Modification of the level unlocking conditions (based on a minimum number of required stars) and addition of a total star counter on the level selection screen,

Adjustment of the sound effects volume in the menu,

Update of an enemy in level 5.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674910/3675501808c5829d50fdc3818936280228be279e.gif"]



Feel free to share your feedback and stay updated on TikTok, X, Instagram or Discord.

See you soon for the next steps <3

notes.title: BIG NEWS! Playable demo release :-)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone :)

I’m happy to announce that the Kubeon demo is now live. The first two levels of the game are playable (the yellow and the green). I hope you enjoy discovering the game's atmosphere. If the visual effects are too intense, you can disable them in the settings.

Are you ready to try it out? The goal is simple: survive.


[previewyoutube="37o67PpET-A;full"][/previewyoutube]


I hope you enjoy this playable demo while waiting for the final game release.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674910/c12a0c9c3eeffa34f543e2d8df1eef889e7a24aa.gif"]





Remember, this is a demo of a game still in development. That means you might encounter a few bugs (hopefully as few as possible).



Feel free to share your feedback and stay updated on TikTok, X, Instagram, or Discord.

See you soon for the next steps <3
